summary: Responsive desktop layout verified across all 3 viewports (1400x900 desktop, 900x1000 tablet, 390x844 mobile). All acceptance criteria met — desktop shows persistent left sidebar (tenant + platform modes), tenants table renders all 10 columns without horizontal scroll at 1400px, mobile keeps the 480px phone frame + bottom tab bar, and tablet correctly falls back to mobile layout (breakpoint >=1024).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — triggered by shadows.card / shadows.strong in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Not blocking but should be migrated. Reference: theme.ts shadow definitions used across login/platform/sidebar.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, likely from a third-party RN component.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents wherever used.
